quantity.name: FR angles (onset SP1 / full flexion MFF / cessation SP2)
quantity.definition: flexion angle at the first silent position SP1 (EMG silence begins in flexion), at maximum forward flexion MFF, and at SP2 (activity resumes in extension); Angles from photographs (35 mm camera, 3 m, right side) with skin markers: Trunk angle (TA) = angle between the long axis of the thigh and the line D1 spinous process - hip-joint centre; Hip angle (HA) = angle between the pelvic plane (ASIS-PSIS line) and the thigh axis; Vertebral angle (VA) = angle between the pelvic plane and the line PSIS - D1 spinous process; all as flexion from erect (deg).

title: Gupta 2001: silence angles with 22 lb held in front or tied posteriorly (11 men)
condition: forward bending with no load, 22 lb in the hands in front, or 22 lb tied around the iliac crest

protocol.summary: Eleven males repeated the bending task holding 22 lb in front and with 22 lb tied posteriorly around the iliac crest.
how_to_simulate: Scale to the weighted-task subgroup (male, 22.8 y, 165 cm, 59 kg; Table 2)
Hand load: 22 lb (10.0 kg) in both hands hanging in front; or the same mass attached to the pelvis posteriorly (iliac crest)
Output: vertebral/hip/trunk angle at lumbar ES silence (SP1) and reactivation (SP2)
protocol.notes: Surface EMG bilaterally over erector spinae at the L3 spinous-process level ~5 cm from the midline (also abdominals, hamstrings, hip extensors); silence = oscilloscope amplitude dropping abruptly to zero (visual, photograph triggered); no normalisation needed (on/off only). Significance (Table 4 footnotes): hip SP1 posterior weight p<0.02; vertebral SP1 with weights p<0.05.
